title: Vampire 10K Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Vampire 10K Bundle marks a bold new chapter for the iconic UK brand, offering a comprehensive package designed for maximum longevity and performance. This exclusive set includes two complete Vampire 10K Prefilled Pod Kits plus two additional Vampire 10K Prefilled Pods. With four total pods included in the bundle—each capable of delivering approximately 10,000 puffs—this setup ensures you have an extensive supply of e-liquid and hardware from the very start. Built around a rechargeable 950mAh battery, the device features a refined brushed metallic satin finish and a clear LCD display that shows your puff count, current mode, and battery level. The system uses a unique pod design where a 2ml prefilled pod is fed by a 10ml refill container, providing 12ml of e-liquid per unit. Each pod delivers Vampire’s signature flavour precision through a dual mesh coil. Users can switch to Turbo Mode for intensified performance and taste clarity, or stick to standard settings for reliable all-day use. With discreet vapour production and smooth 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid, this bundle offers a dependable and satisfying Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience. Available Flavours: The Vampire 10K series offers a diverse range of vibrant profiles. You can enjoy unique blends such as the exotic Dragon Fruit Watermelon Smoothie or the zesty Raspberry Apple Juice, alongside refreshing classics like Mint Mojito and Watermelon Ice. For those who prefer punchy fruit combinations, options like Red Raspberry Blast and Sweet & Sour Cherry deliver a rounded and satisfying vape. How To Set Up Your Vampire 10K Device Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod firmly into the device. Step 2 Ensure the 10ml refill section is attached securely. Step 3 Inhale to activate and vape — no buttons or setup required. Step 4 Switch to Turbo Mode if you desire enhanced flavour and vapour output. Step 5 Recharge via USB-C when required (cable sold separately). ✅ Ready to vape
